one_line: Ahom Borphukan and river-war commander who led the defence of Assam at the Battle of Saraighat, 1671.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early 40s, athletic and battle-hardened with a commander’s bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp jawline, medium-brown Assamese complexion, straight nose, intense narrow dark-brown eyes under slightly arched brows, a neatly trimmed moustache with light stubble along the jaw, default expression focused and resolute with a hint of stern warmth.
appearance.hair: Black hair tied into a tight, shoulder-length topknot at the back of the head, sides smooth and neat; front hairline clean with a few short loose strands near the temples; wears a simple deep-red cloth headband wrapped around the forehead, knotted at the back with short tails.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length, long-sleeved cotton tunic (kurta-style) in muted off-white with a narrow round collar and side slits, over a fitted sleeveless quilted cotton coat (padding like a gambeson) in deep forest-green with vertical stitching and a plain brown leather belt at the waist; below, he has slightly loose, ankle-length cotton trousers in dull indigo blue tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots with simple stitching; over one shoulder and across the chest he drapes a narrow woven gamusa-like sash in white with thin red borders and small red geometric motifs at the ends; his forearms are wrapped with dark-brown cloth bracers, and he wears minimal jewellery—small plain brass stud earrings and a single thin brass bangle on his right wrist.
appearance.signature: A long Assamese-style spear with a leaf-shaped steel blade and a dark wooden shaft about his own height, the butt capped with metal; he carries it in his right hand, and slung across his back is a simple round wooden shield reinforced with metal studs.

ref_desc: Lachit Borphukan is a mid-30s Assamese commander with an oval medium-brown face, black topknot hair and red headband, wearing an off-white tunic, forest-green quilted sleeveless coat, indigo trousers, brown boots, white-red sash, and carrying a long spear and round wooden shield.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Lachit Borphukan as a dignified Ahom commander: a mid-30s athletic Assamese man with an oval medium-brown face, intense dark-brown eyes, straight nose, neat moustache and light jaw stubble, giving a focused, resolute expression. His black hair is tied into a tight shoulder-length topknot with smooth sides and a few loose strands by the temples, and he wears a simple deep-red cloth headband wrapped around his forehead, knotted at the back with short tails. Dress him in a long-sleeved, knee-length off-white cotton tunic with a narrow round collar and side slits, over a fitted sleeveless quilted cotton coat in forest green with vertical stitching, cinched by a plain brown leather belt. Show slightly loose ankle-length cotton trousers in dull indigo blue tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots with simple stitching. Drape a narrow white woven sash with thin red borders and small red geometric motifs diagonally from one shoulder across his chest, and wrap his forearms with dark-brown cloth bracers; add small brass stud earrings and a thin brass bangle on his right wrist. Place a simple round wooden shield with metal studs on his back, and in his right hand a long Assamese-style spear with a leaf-shaped steel blade and dark wooden shaft, metal-capped at the butt. Use a grounded colour scheme of off-white, forest green, deep red, indigo blue and brown leather, and show front, side and back views to emphasise the consistent face, hair, clothing and weapons.
